title: Bigfoot reappears in Monroe after six decades

content:
It’s a well-known fact that news travels fast in small towns. When a father and son claimed that they saw a cryptid known as Bigfoot in Monroe, the media picked this story up right away. 

The media presence brought along a national scientific organization who specialize in reporting sightings all across North America. It is called The Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.

On May 18, 2025, a father and son were bow fishing a marshy area of Plum Creek by the Monroe County Inmate Dormitory Facility when things took a turn. 

According to what they told BFRO, as they were walking towards the marsh, their movement stirred something up causing some trees to shake. They thought a group of deer caused the rustling right then. It happened when the father went to turn on his police scanner app when they heard sirens. They heard something hit the ground from a nearby tree. 

The father claims this thing, after leaving the tree, was crouched down in the brush and approaching him until their dog chased it off.

BFRO listed this sighting as a class A, meaning it was a clear sighting with minimal chance of misidentification, often including well-documented footprints. However, there was no mention of footprints or pictures of footprints.

After this supposed sighting broke the news, it left many speculating the truthfulness. Many pointed out how close this was to many cannabis stores while others doubted one would be so close to civilization. 

In my opinion, I always stay cautious and skeptical when there isn’t good proof provided. However, it doesn’t mean I am completely doubtful. Monroe used to have more farms and wooded areas, a better habitat for Bigfoot to live in than it currently is due to urbanization. 

I would like to point out there have been confirmed black bears in areas near Monroe since this sighting happened. This wouldn’t account for everything the father and son described, but it is a possibility many had ruled out at the point in time.

However, there is something else most media didn’t report when this incident occurred. This wouldn’t be the first time a sighting has happened. There have been multiple reports of sightings in and near Monroe. 

Most notably, there was an incident after several reports around the area in 1965 which broke national news. 17-year-old Christine Van Acker was driving through Frenchtown Charter Township near Cottonwood Creek with her mother in the car when something emerged from the ditch.

 It was reported this creature hit the car before reaching in and grabbing Van Acker by the hair. She was then violently shaken, causing her head and face to hit the door multiple times which resulted in a black eye.

While looking into this, I watched a YouTube film made by Small Town Monsters called “The Monroe Monster Mystery: Bigfoot is Still Out There!” and wasn’t very impressed. Some details I found interesting, but I mostly found myself bored.

I’m not too certain about this. The idea of a large creature reaching into a car and doing such things seems pretty far-fetched, but not impossible. 

Maybe the cryptid was curious and didn’t quite understand its strength. They do describe Bigfoot as an ape-like creature, and we still observe how smart apes are to this day. 

While looking for information, I came across a theory I found interesting. When the 1965 incident happened, Fermi had its first area being finished up. Some people speculated this may not have been Bigfoot and instead an escaped creature from Fermi’s lab.

Whether these sightings were true or false will always be a matter of debate, but there is no doubt that stories like this will continue. Myths of unexplainable creatures are a part of many cultures, and Bigfoot is one of North America’s staples that goes back for centuries.
